tooltip.gfbs_doors.change_skin: Shift + Right-click to change skin (Creative only)
tooltip.gfbs_doors.elevator: Right-click to move; hold another elevator and right-click to extend
tooltip.gfbs_doors.door_configurator.1: Right-click a door to set its redstone mode and manual control
tooltip.gfbs_doors.configurator_hint: Use the Door Configurator on a door to change its redstone mode
gui.gfbs_doors.config.title: Door Configurator
gui.gfbs_doors.config.manual.tooltip: When disabled, this door can only be controlled by redstone.
gui.gfbs_doors.config.hint: Click an option to apply it immediately
gui.gfbs_doors.config.force_toggle.toolt: Debug: immediately switch the door to its next state (ignores redstone and manual control).
gui.gfbs_doors.mode.none.tooltip: Ignores redstone entirely; cannot be controlled by redstone.
gui.gfbs_doors.mode.pulse.tooltip: Each redstone pulse toggles the door open or closed.
gui.gfbs_doors.mode.trigger.tooltip: Stays open while powered; closes when the signal ends.
gui.gfbs_doors.mode.inverted.tooltip: Stays closed while powered; opens when the signal ends.
gui.gfbs_doors.mode.gfbs_closed.tooltip: GFBS facility normally-closed blast door: ignores redstone and manual control, stays closed; only commands can operate it.
gui.gfbs_doors.mode.gfbs_open.tooltip: GFBS checkpoint normally-open blast door: ignores redstone and manual control, stays open; only commands can operate it.
message.gfbs_doors.no_permission: Only creative mode or operators can change door settings.
